case_number: 2025 INSC 309; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No(s). 3044 of 2021)
summary: Forgery conviction appeal; handwriting expert evidence admissibility; Murari Lal precedent on expert testimony; no requirement for mandatory corroboration; photostat copy as secondary evidence; postal cover handwriting disputed; conviction upheld due to sound expert reasoning and corroborative evidence.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.120B, s.468, s.471, s.109
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld.
